description: A bright, airy primary bedroom with a balanced, symmetrically composed layout. The walls are smooth white, and the ceiling is flat white with no applied detail. Two double-hung windows with white horizontal blinds and sheer grey linen curtains flank the central headboard wall, flooding the space with soft diffused daylight. A large tufted cream velvet wingback bed with a tall diamond-button headboard anchors the center wall; the bed is made with soft lavender-grey bedding and an assortment of throw pillows — two dusty blue velvet bolsters, a cream tasseled lumbar, and two grey textured squares. On either side of the bed, two-drawer nightstands in a pale cerulean blue-painted finish with brass knob hardware hold small accessories — a stack of books on the left, a small decorative box on the right. Two framed large-format abstract prints in soft terracotta and tan on cream backgrounds hang symmetrically above the headboard. In the foreground, two matching cream velvet barrel-back accent chairs with brass-tipped legs sit on a vintage-style area rug in ivory, dusty blue, and warm ochre tones. A white sculptural pedestal side table between them holds a coffee mug and a small book. A cream knit throw is draped casually over the left chair. The hardwood floor is light-toned oak. The mood is serene, soft, and transitional-modern with gentle color accents.
